description: Search Global Trade Alert for trade and industrial policy measures, including tariffs, subsidies and export controls. Find implementing jurisdictions, affected products, implementation dates, and links to the underlying records and official sources. Global Trade Alert tracks 60 economies since 2009.

defaultPrompt: Summarise harmful measures affecting Brazil in the past year by implementing country, product and trade instrument.
Find HS 84 barriers affecting China, South Korea or Japan, but not Brazil. Assess openings for Brazilian exporters.
Compare US tariffs by product and origin since 1 Jan 2025; explain applicable statutes, exemptions and coverage gaps.
